# June Discord Utility Platform
> Technical architecture, security hardening, and complete command reference for June, an invite-only Discord utility, forensic, and temporary mail platform.

## System Overview
- Runtime: Node.js 22 LTS with single-process singleton architecture, sliding-window rate limiters, and worker thread sandboxes.
- Persistence: Node.js 22 built-in node:sqlite in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode delivering sub-millisecond local queries without third-party native C++ build toolchains.
- Ephemeral Email: Self-hosted Stalwart JMAP mail engine (RFC 8621 / RFC 8620) with deterministic 60-minute inboxes and real-time Server-Sent Events.
- Network Isolation: Strict IP destination filtering, pinned socket connections preventing DNS rebinding (TOCTOU), and 500ms ReDoS worker watchdogs.
- User Data Sovereignty: GDPR-style atomic data inspection (/data view), export (/data export), and permanent purge (/data delete).

## Core Documentation Sitemap
- [Platform Overview](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/): Architecture overview and system philosophy.
- [System Topology & Runtime](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/architecture/): Gateway ingestion, rate limiters, worker boundaries.
- [Security & Hardening](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/architecture/security): IP firewall, socket pinning, ReDoS mitigation.
- [SQLite Storage Engine](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/architecture/storage): Zero-dependency node:sqlite WAL persistence.
- [JMAP Ephemeral Mail](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/architecture/jmap-mail): Stalwart JMAP mailboxes and lease enforcement.
- [Command Reference Matrix](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/commands/): Master matrix of all slash commands.
- [General Utilities](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/commands/general): Productivity, reminders, temporary mail, data sovereignty.
- [OSINT & Recon](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/commands/osint): Lawful reconnaissance, DNS, whois, certificate transparency.
- [Threat Intelligence](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/commands/threat): Forensic analysis, port scanning, URL sandboxes.
- [Web & Media](https://docs.june.4ofl.dev/commands/web): Network diagnostics, IP geolocation, website inspection.
- [Live Telemetry Endpoint](https://june.4ofl.dev/api/status): Live operational state, shard latency, and provider health.
